erin_fin: FYI - Customer HelixAI was charged full June reserved commit on INV-2026-00890 but their Dedicated pool went live 2026-06-12. Need prorate + check SLA credits.

sam_billing: Pulling invoice. Reserved commit $60,000; overage $0; tax $6,600; total $66,600. Invoice date 2026-06-01.

nina_sre: Infra shows activation `2026-06-12T09:12:04Z`. No platform downtime.

erin_fin: June has 30 days; active days 12..30 inclusive = 19 days. Prorate factor 19/30 = 0.6333. Prorated reserved = $60,000 * 0.6333 ≈ $38,000 => refund ≈ $22,000.

sam_billing: We can post negative line for $22,000 and apply as credit to next invoice. GL 4305.

erin_fin: Recommend we apply prorate refund $22,000 and SLA credit $150 (per legal guidance) as negative lines. Net credit $22,150. Apply as invoice credit. Approve?

aditya_sales: Approve. I'll notify customer and offer cash refund only if they specifically request it (will need CFO signoff).
